title: CardCorpus set
description: One set: its description, tell, print runs, versions and links, and every card with its variants.

id.description: The set's id. Treat it as opaque: it never changes once published.

catalog.description: The catalog the set belongs to.

name.description: The set's name as it prints it, in its language. Where no source gives the printed name yet, its English name (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#names).

englishName.description: The set's name in English, on every set: "Expansion Pack (Base Set)" (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#names).

era.description: Its era, by pointer, which stays when the era is renamed.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `era`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The era's id (eras.json).

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

englishName.description: A copy of the target's own `englishName`.

type.description: What the set is, by how its cards reached people.

language.description: The language its cards are printed in: its catalog's, apart from a box like the Pikachu World Collection, which holds cards in several (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#foreign-prints).

position.description: Its place among its catalog's sets of one release date, where the data orders them.

line.description: The line the set is one part of, where several of our sets came out as one product or range of products (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#lines).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `line`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The line's id (lines.json).

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

part.description: The words that tell this set from the line's others: "Blaziken Tech" for "2004 World Championships Deck: Blaziken Tech", "Latias" for "EX Trainer Kit Latias".

printedTotal.description: The total its card numbers print (the 102 of 4/102), where they print one.

actualTotal.description: How many cards the set has by its own count, secret cards included, where known.

cardCount.description: How many cards the set has in its `cards`; always present, 0 included.

released.description: When the set came out came out, as precisely as is known (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#release-dates).

printedCode.description: The set code and language mark its cards print where they name their set, as printed (in the set code's letter case): "PBL FR", "M6a F", "CSV3C", "SV9a". Null where the cards print no code of their own (Base Set); absent where nobody has checked yet (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#printed-codes).

symbol.description: The set symbol, the small mark its cards print (an icon a source gives for a set that prints none).

linkCount.description: How many links the set has to other sets; always present, 0 included.

description.description: What we wrote about the set, for people to read (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#descriptions).

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

tell.description: How to tell this set's print of a card from other sets' prints of the same painting, in a few words, naming only what every card of the set prints (its symbol, its numbering); a card's own `tell` stands in for it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#set-tells).

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

printRuns.description: The set's print runs whose place is known, earliest first, by edition (`unlimited` also stands for variants with no edition), each with what we say of it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#print-runs).

released.description: When the run first came out, as precisely as is known (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#release-dates).

tell.description: How to spot it, in a few words.

standard.description: Present where the run's variants are the set's standard ones and that isn't Unlimited (a Japanese booster set's 1st Edition).

versions.description: The versions the set's product was sold in, earliest first, where the version decides some of the cards in it (pack designs of a set sold in waves, binders of two colours); a card found in only some names them in its own `onlyIn` (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#versions).

id.description: The set version's id, unique in its set's `versions`.

released.description: When the version came out, as precisely as is known (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#release-dates).

distributions.description: How every variant of the set was handed out, where all came out one way (a Prize Pack series, a Burger King collection), named once here and not on each variant (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#distributions).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `distribution`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The distribution's id (distributions/{id}.json).

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

category.description: A copy of the target's own `category`.

as.description: How the variant came out of a distribution that also handed out others: as a `prize` or to `staff`.

region.description: Where it was handed out, where only in some places.

backImage.description: The back every card of the set shares, where that is unlike the usual one (a World Championships Deck's).

links.description: The set's links to other sets.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The set's id (sets/{catalog}.json).

relation.description: What the other set is to this one.

direction.description: Which way the link reads: `outgoing` from this set to the other, or `incoming` from the other to this one.

sameCardCount.description: How many of the two sets' cards are linked as the same card; always present, 0 included.

cardSummary.title: CardSummary
cardSummary.description: A card as every list gives it: where it is (`$kind`, `set`, `id`, the pointer to it) and what a tile draws from, each field the card's own, whole. A card in its set's file has every one of these, and the rest of its fields.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `card`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The card's id, unique in its set. Treat it as opaque: it never changes once published.

name.description: The card's name as it prints it, in its language: "リザードン" on a Japanese Charizard. Where no source gives the printed name yet, its English name (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#names).

englishName.description: The card's name in English, on every card, the same as `name` on an English card: "Charizard". What to search and sort by across languages (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#names).

subtitle.description: The smaller name the card prints beside its own, as it prints it, in its language, where it prints one: "Professeur Chen" on a French Professor's Research, "オーキド博士" on a Japanese one. Where we have no printed subtitle, the English one on a card whose `name` is its English one (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#subtitles).

englishSubtitle.description: The smaller name the card prints beside its own, in English, where it prints one: the professor on a Professor's Research ("Professor Oak"), the boss on a Boss's Orders ("Ghetsis"). It says which of the cards sharing a name this is, but isn't part of the name: a deck counts them all as one card. Always one of the card's `characters` (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#subtitles). Our own pages show it joined to the name: "Professor's Research (Professor Oak)".

number.description: Its number as printed ("4/102", "SWSH001"), and that number without its set total.

printed.description: The number as printed, where the card prints one.

short.description: The number without its set total: "4" of "4/102", and the whole number where it prints no total ("SWSH001"). What a tile shows and a sort reads.

rarity.description: Its rarity, as its mark reads (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#rarity).

language.description: The language its text is printed in: its set's, or another where its product held a foreign print (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#foreign-prints). Every card has one.

released.description: When the card first came out, in any of its variants: its own date, or, in a set whose cards came out together, the set's (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#release-dates).

date.description: The date, as precisely as is known: 2001, 2001-09 or 2001-09-22; absent where neither the card's nor the set's is known.

sort.description: Sorts cards oldest first, every list alike: compare as plain strings. An ordering convention, not a date; every card has one.

inferred.description: `true` where the card's own date is an estimate: no page dates the card itself, so its year is borrowed from another language's print or worked out from its neighbours, its copyright line or its product (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#release-dates). Absent otherwise.

credit.description: The credit as printed ("CR CG gangs & K. Hoshiba").

artists.description: The people the credit names, in credit order, each by pointer with the name as this card prints it; a director's credit names no one.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `artist`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The artist's id (artists.json).

name.description: The artist's name as this card prints it.

species.description: The species it shows, each once, in the order the card shows them, each with the forms of it the card shows where that is more than its ordinary form.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `species`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The species' National Pokédex number.

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

forms.description: The forms of the species the card shows, in the card's order, where it shows something other than the species' ordinary form alone (a Gigantamax, a regional form, two forms at once): every form it shows then, the ordinary one included. Usually absent: the card shows the ordinary form alone. One entry on a card of a single other form (a Mega, a Gigantamax, a regional form). Two or more where the card shows several forms of the species, the ordinary one listed with the others where it is among them (Tatsugiri's three: `978`, `978:droopy`, `978:stretchy`).

id.description: The form's id: the dex number, with ":<key>" for a form other than the default ("52", "52:galar"). With the entry's own `id` as `species` it is a form pointer.

name.description: The form's name as this card gives it.

picture.description: The picture to show for the card (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pictures): `front.image`, and `front.of`, the variant it is a picture of (its default variant, another variant standing in, or, for a reprint with no picture of any variant, its original's); `back`, where its back is unlike the usual one; `oversized` where the card only came as a jumbo or its picture is a jumbo variant's.

front.description: The front: a picture id, and whose picture it is.

of.description: The variant it is a picture of, where that isn't the variant it is on (on a card, always).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `variant`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

id.description: The variant's id, unique among its card's variants.

relation.description: Whose card it is, where not the card's own: `original`, the card a reprint with no picture of its own reprints. Label the picture by it ("the original's picture") without following the card's links.

watermark.description: Whose watermark the picture carries, where it carries one.

back.description: Its back, where that is unlike the usual one.

oversized.description: Present where the card only came as a jumbo or its picture is a jumbo variant's.

defaultVariant.description: The variant that stands for the card where one must (prices, a tile): by id in `variants`. Whose photo the card's picture is can be another variant's: read `picture.front.of` for that.

painting.description: The painting it prints, where another card prints it too. Its file (paintings/{id}.json) holds the card's links: the same card in other languages, the card it reprints and its reprints, and its parallels, with every card they name (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#links).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `painting`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The painting's own id, which never changes: its first print's English name and a short code, such as `charizard-k3f9`. Where it was first printed is `firstPrint`'s to say, corrected there when research finds an earlier print.

card.title: Card
card.description: A card of the set: a card summary (`CardSummary`) with the rest of its fields.

description.description: What we wrote about the card, for people to read (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#descriptions).

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

tell.description: How to tell this card's print where it differs from its set's `tell`.

text.description: The tell; null where the card doesn't carry the set's tell (a basic Energy with no set mark).

eReaderLayout.description: Where it prints its e-Reader strip, as its pictures show: `e_card` (along the bottom, under the number, and down the left edge, as Expedition to Skyridge do) or `ex` (one strip along the bottom, under the weakness row, as the EX sets do). Absent where it prints none or nobody has looked (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#e-reader-strip).

characters.description: The people the card names, in the card's order: its subject (a Supporter's trainer), or the owner of its Pokémon (Misty's Psyduck).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `character`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The character's id (characters.json).

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

role.description: What they are on the card: its `subject`, or the `owner` of its Pokémon.

differsInSet.description: Present where its set prints the same painting on other cards too (its parallels, and any other card of the set around that painting): what tells this card from them, as the axes of its default variant that not all of them share, such as `{"finish": "pokeball_pattern"}`. On a card with parallels it is always there, `{}` where nothing tells it from them, so a list of the set's cards labels every card with parallels by it, with no links to follow (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#telling-variants-apart).

material.description: What it is printed on, where that isn't ordinary card.

printVersion.description: Which of a pair it is, 1 or 2, on the rare pairs of different cards in one set with the same name that the numbering doesn't tell apart. The Celadon City Gym deck's two Erika's Oddish, both numbered No. 043, are 1 and 2; so are Pikachu World Collection's two numberless Pikachu, the blue binder's and the green binder's. It counts within the pair and is not a pointer into the set's `versions` (that is `onlyInSetVersions`).

onlyInSetVersions.description: Present where its set is sold in versions (the set's `versions`) and this card is in only some of them: those versions. A card without it is in every version (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#versions).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set-version`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The set version's id, unique in its set's `versions`.

pieces.description: Present where the card is one piece of a card printed in pieces, a LEGEND's half or a V-UNION's quarter: the whole card's pieces (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pieces).

format.description: What kind of card in pieces it is: `legend` or `v_union`.

position.description: This piece's position, counted from 1 in vocabulary.json's `positions` for the format.

cards.description: Every piece of the whole card, this one included, in reading order.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `card`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

variants.description: Its variants, in role order; the standard one, or the first on a test-only card, supplies the card picture.

printRuns.description: On a card printed in more than one run: its standard variant and print runs, in printing order (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#telling-variants-apart).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `variant`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

id.description: The variant's id, unique among its card's variants.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: One variant of a card: a finish, stamp, edition or other version of it that exists as its own physical print.

id.description: The variant's id, unique within its card: its physical axes as a slug, or "plain". Treat it as opaque: it never changes once published.

name.description: What the card's variant strip calls it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#telling-variants-apart).

role.description: What this variant is on its card; variants are listed in role order (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#version-roles).

material.description: What it is printed on, where that isn't ordinary card.

serialCode.description: Its serial code; always present on a `serial_code` copy.

serialCodeVariantOf.description: Another code of the same physical version, by its pointer; always present on a `serial_code` copy.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `variant`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

id.description: The variant's id, unique among its card's variants.

eReaderStrip.description: What it prints where its card prints the e-Reader strip (the card's `eReaderLayout`), as its own picture shows: the dot code, holo bars in its place (a reverse holo, a holo rare), or nothing (`blank`: an EX card without a strip). Absent where nobody has looked (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#e-reader-strip).

editionMark.description: The edition mark it prints: `first_edition`, the 1st Edition symbol. Its edition's mark (vocabulary `edition`, `mark`) unless the variant says otherwise, as Base Set Machamp's stamped ©1999-2000 4th print does. Absent where it prints none (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#edition-mark).

printRun.description: The edition of the set's print run (its `printRuns`) the variant came out in, where the set lists that run: look it up there. Equal to `edition` wherever both are present; `unlimited` on a variant with no `edition` whose set has runs; absent where the variant's edition has no known place among the set's runs (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#telling-variants-apart).

differsFromStandard.description: Its axes that the card's standard variant doesn't share (all of them on a card with no standard variant); none on the standard variant.

material.description: What it is printed on, where that isn't ordinary card.

tell.description: How to spot it on the card, in a sentence or two.

picture.description: The variant's picture (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pictures): its own, or, with `front.of`, another variant's standing in for one it lacks (the standard variant's; on the standard variant, the first other variant's); and its back, where that is unlike the usual one.

front.description: The front: a picture id, and whose picture it is.

of.description: The variant it is a picture of, where that isn't the variant it is on (on a card, always).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `variant`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

id.description: The variant's id, unique among its card's variants.

relation.description: Whose card it is, where not the card's own: `original`, the card a reprint with no picture of its own reprints. Label the picture by it ("the original's picture") without following the card's links.

watermark.description: Whose watermark the picture carries, where it carries one.

back.description: Its back, where that is unlike the usual one.

description.description: What we wrote about the variant, for people to read (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#descriptions).

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

distributions.description: How the variant was handed out beyond its set's own `distributions`: each distribution by its pointer, with its name and category, and `as` and `region` where they apply.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `distribution`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The distribution's id (distributions/{id}.json).

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

category.description: A copy of the target's own `category`.

as.description: How the variant came out of a distribution that also handed out others: as a `prize` or to `staff`.

region.description: Where it was handed out, where only in some places.
